entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: The blue-green College of Numeromancy at Strixhaven University, whose mages use math and Fractals.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: University on Arcavios containing the Quandrix college.

entities.name: Tanazir Quandrix
entities.description: Elder dragon who founded the college.

entities.name: Fractals
entities.description: Artificial life forms replicating patterns of nature, scalable in size, used as Quandrix mascots.

entities.name: Arithmodrome
entities.description: Inner realm inside a water sculpture where normal physical laws do not apply.

entities.name: Cultivarium
entities.description: Sun-drenched garden that intensifies growth magic.

entities.name: Torus Hall
entities.description: Key central building of the Quandrix campus with a shifting three-dimensional grid.

entities.name: Kianne
entities.description: Green-aligned Elf dean of Quandrix, former and deceased.

entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: Blue-aligned Owlin dean of Quandrix, former and deceased.

relations.quote: The founder of the college is the elder dragon Tanazir Quandrix .
Kianne was the green-aligned Elf dean of Quandrix.
Imbraham is Quandrix's blue-aligned Owlin dean.
Quandrix is the College of Numeromancy at Strixhaven University
